item.title: Opening a bank account abroad
item.context_text: You started a master's course in Germany last week. Your university needs a local bank account for your scholarship payments, so you go to a bank near the campus.
item.objective_text: Find out what documents you need, understand the bank assistant, and write a short message to book an appointment.
item.target_grammar: need to / have to + verb (I need to bring my passport.)
item.cultural_note: In many European banks you need an appointment to open an account. Bring all your documents the first time; if one is missing, you usually have to come back another day.
success_conditions: Know which three documents to bring
Understand when the card and the PIN arrive
Write a clear message to book an appointment

children.title: Read the bank's web page
children.instructions: Read the information for new students. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
STUDENT ACCOUNTS
Open a free student account in 20 minutes.
Please bring:
1. your passport
2. your student card or letter from the university
3. proof of address (for example, your rental contract)
Appointments: Monday to Friday, 9:00–16:00. Book online or by email. We do not open accounts without an appointment.

questions.prompt: Which document is NOT on the list?
questions.explanation: The list has a passport, a student card or letter, and proof of address. A driving licence is not on it.

questions.prompt: Can you open an account without an appointment?
questions.explanation: "We do not open accounts without an appointment."

children.title: Listen to the bank assistant
children.instructions: You call the bank with a question. Listen to the assistant. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text: Good morning, thanks for calling. Yes, you can open the account at your appointment, and it only takes about twenty minutes. Your debit card arrives by post after five to seven working days. The PIN comes in a separate letter, a day or two after the card. Please don't throw that letter away! You can use the mobile app on the same day, after we open the account.

questions.prompt: How does the debit card arrive?
questions.explanation: "Your debit card arrives by post after five to seven working days."

options: A day or two after the card
questions.explanation: "The PIN comes in a separate letter, a day or two after the card."

questions.prompt: What can you use on the first day?
questions.explanation: "You can use the mobile app on the same day."

children.title: Book an appointment
children.instructions: Write a short email to the bank. Say who you are, ask for an appointment and give a day and time that is good for you.
children.prompt_text:
To: students@bank.example
Subject: Appointment for a student account
children.goal: Book an appointment to open a student account.
children.model_answer:
Dear Sir or Madam,
My name is Dilnoza Karimova. I am a new master's student at the university. I would like to open a student account. Can I have an appointment on Tuesday or Wednesday morning, at 10:00? I have my passport, my student card and my rental contract.
Thank you,
Dilnoza
